name: @fpay/lp
_comment: The LP (liquidity provider) console — a separate app on its own domain so the marketplace never ships in the payer's bundle. Auth depth matches @fpay/web, not @fpay/admin: staking signs a real USDC transfer, so this app needs the Privy embedded wallet and a signer, not just a bearer token. No Tailwind — it styles through @fpay/ui's RN shim. `tsx` is hoisted from the root, same as @fpay/web.
